$comment: Per-client Driver Eco Dashboard MAILING rollout permission.
Read by jobs/ecodriving_dashboard/dashboard_rollout.py, and ONLY when a run
was explicitly invoked with --with-dashboard. A default (legacy) Eco Driving
mailing run never reads this file and is unaffected by its contents.
Dashboard-enabled sending requires BOTH conditions, and neither alone:
1. the explicit --with-dashboard opt-in on the invocation. A scheduled
fire acquires exactly that option, and only for a (client, dataset)
pair declared in ops/eco_mailing_production_schedule.json;
2. enabled: true for that client here.
This permission is deliberately NOT derived from ECO_DASHBOARD_BASE_URL or
ECO_DASHBOARD_PUBLISHER_URL being configured. Provisioning a publisher must
never become a silent mailing rollout.
A client that is not named here is DISABLED. New and unknown clients never
inherit a rollout. A wildcard entry is refused as a malformed declaration, so
"all clients enabled" is not expressible and cannot become the default.
Enabling a client later is one explicit, reviewable edit to this file — flip
its enabled to true — and requires no change to any mailing business logic.
That edit is a separate, separately authorized owner decision.
CURRENT OWNER DECISION:

include or publish a dashboard at this stage.
BRAVO00016 - dashboard mailing ENABLED by explicit owner authorization.
An Eco run for this client may carry a dashboard, but only
when that run was invoked with --with-dashboard. Enabling
this entry sends nothing by itself.
